name: women_clothing_review
description:
Predict the score of a customer review of clothing items (sold by an anonymous retailer)
    based on the review text, how much positive feedback the review has received (numeric), and
    additional features about the product like its department (categorical). The data were collected by:
    https://www.kaggle.com/nicapotato/womens-ecommerce-clothing-reviews
  
 Dataset found from the paper: Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
creator: Xingjian Shi, Jonas Mueller, Nick Erickson, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
citation: Shi, X., Mueller, J., Erickson, N., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. (2021). Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
